name: TCL 75C845X2
summary: TCL 75C845X2 ships with a Samba TV viewing tracker and TCL promos. TidyTV is a free phone app that turns them off, with a backup and one-tap undo.
intro: This UK and Europe TCL runs Google TV on Android 14 and ships with Samba TV, which tracks what is on screen, TCL analytics, log upload and account sign-in nags. It also has TCL Live FAST channels, content pushed at boot, push messages and promos, retail demo and hotel mode apps, an e-manual and a cleaner.

The list was applied on a real 75 inch set. Home, the new launcher and its dock apps worked afterwards. TidyTV turns the apps off from your phone over Wi-Fi, saves a backup first and never deletes anything, so each app can be switched back on. Chromecast, AirPlay and the game bar were kept.
keep: Chromecast, AirPlay and the game bar
Live TV and HDMI (the TCL TV app)
The Input source panel and the TCL dashboard
notes: This owner uses SmartTube, so YouTube and Google Play Movies are on the list. Keep them on if you use them.
Switching the stock home off empties the Accounts and profiles list. The accounts stay stored.

faq.q: Will the voice button still work on my TCL 75C845X2?
faq.a: This list does not mention turning off the voice assistant, so the mic button is left as it is.
Chromecast and AirPlay are kept. Miracast and TCL's T-Cast phone mirroring are on the list and are switched off.

faq.q: Can I get the old home screen back?
faq.a: Yes. Restore everything turns every app back on and puts the stock Google TV home screen back.
